published_prior_art.cite: Fry2024MomentsSC: fixed-donor synthetic-control moment asymptotics use factor-loading span structure, though not this risk graph.
CanenSong2026SimplexWeight: simplex-constrained optimizer inference uses polyhedral-cone geometry; the continuum risk-graph atlas is a routine but useful specialization.
CattaneoFengTitiunik2021PredictionIntervals: synthetic-control prediction uncertainty propagates fitted-weight and future-error sources, but not the proposed MSE moment vector.

CanenSong2026SimplexWeight gives inference for a simplex-valued optimizer, while CattaneoFengTitiunik2021PredictionIntervals targets future outcomes; neither supplies a same-panel band for the full population-MSE graph.
Geyer1994ConstrainedM and FangSantos2019Directional cover constrained/directionally differentiable local maps; the moving-query KKT application is specialized.
FreybergerRai2018UniformBands characterizes taut projection bands; the curve-diameter acceptance-set loss is a distinct but adjacent reduction.
EvansHansenStark2005MinimaxConfidence and SchaferStark2009OptimalRegions optimize additive expected size, not unrestricted randomized simultaneous bands under maximum curve width.
LeCamYang2000 supplies general experiment-comparison tools, but no located compact Gaussian--Wishart transfer for this moving-KKT curve loss.
FreybergerRai2018UniformBands restricts its band class, while the proposed result concerns unrestricted randomized bands and observed-panel transfer.
Geyer1994ConstrainedM supplies the general tangent-cone distinction; the signed comparison under this new loss is a secondary specialization.

soundness_flags.label: def:global-moment-region and def:global-risk-band
soundness_flags.one_line: The region quantifies \(\theta\in\mathcal M_n\) although \(\mathcal M_n\) is defined as a class of laws, and no global parameter space or map \(\theta\mapsto P_\theta\) is defined for the displayed \(R_{P_\theta}\).

soundness_flags.label: thm:local-panel-minimax
soundness_flags.one_line: \(C_n\) is already the particular global projection band, so the existential and universal claims about arbitrary observed-panel bands require a separately quantified band sequence and an explicit local coverage class.

soundness_flags.label: prop:hinge-sanity-check
soundness_flags.one_line: The numerical panel instance does not specify the one-dimensional chart/path, \(T_{\mathrm{post}}/n\) limit, or parameter components varied by \(u\), so its asserted information \(5/4\) and \(\Psi(u,t)\) are not determined.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:local-panel-minimax
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The claimed exact value is restricted to the fixed-dimensional, known-rank, locally i.i.d. Gaussian submodel; it does not assert that the global mixing-class band is itself globally minimax.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact compact-local minimax width for observed Gaussian panels under ass:local-gaussian-submodel, conditional on completing the stated transfer construction.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper constructs an asymptotically uniformly valid confidence set for a simplex-valued optimization-solution weight using projection on a polyhedral cone.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract, p. 119; Section 2 restriction discussion, p. 121
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper characterizes taut projection bands and restricts its class by a realization-invariant confidence-set shape, expressly ruling out random selection among valid bands.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 116(536), 2021
source_verification_receipts.locator: Article abstract and publication record, pp. 1865--1880
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article develops synthetic-control prediction intervals accounting for pre-treatment weight construction and post-treatment prediction error.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 104(487), 2009
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper approximates minimax expected-size confidence sets over compact parameter spaces by finite-prior and Monte Carlo methods; its loss is expected set measure.
The paper studies fixed-control synthetic-control moment methods and asymptotics as pre-treatment periods grow, with post-treatment averages when both panel segments grow.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define a global admissible parameter space \(\Theta_n\), a measurable map \(\theta\mapsto P_\theta\), and write \(E_n\subseteq\Theta_n\); then state the rank and regularity constraints directly on that parameterization.

Rewrite the local minimax theorem with a generic band sequence \(\widetilde C_n\), an explicit compact-local honesty condition, and separate attainment/lower-bound quantifiers from the global band \(C_n\).
Make the hinge a fully specified one-dimensional Gaussian subexperiment, including the chart direction, \(\lambda\), fixed nuisance coordinates, and the calculation establishing information \(5/4\).

Add Martinez and Vives-i-Bastida, Bayesian and Frequentist Inference for Synthetic Controls (March 2026 preliminary arXiv draft), as adjacent non-archival WIP: it studies factor-model predictive-function inference but does not provide this risk graph or band-loss result.

recommended_next_step: Repair the three well-posedness/coherence defects, retain the accepted Gaussian-local scope, and then advance the field-tier kernel to Stage 0.
